entries.5bcf66342a925d39: SHINOZAKIYA,INC. is a company that plans and develops processed soybean foods such as tofu and soy milk, and sells them through directly operated stores and franchise stores of "Sandaime Mozo" and other channels.
entries.5cc42df225d32d85: Retail business through directly operated stores under the store name "Sandaime Mozō".
entries.7ccb49ed5e71f64d: It is a tofu-version SPA that handles soybean-processed foods from planning and development through to sales, with production outsourced to external partner companies, and earns revenue from store sales of 'Sandaime Mozo' and from wholesale and mail-order sales.
entries.9fefef0569ac1467: SHINOZAKIYA,INC. is a company with its registered head office in Kasukabe City, Saitama Prefecture, and its head office functions in Koshigaya City, Saitama Prefecture, and it has no subsidiaries or affiliates. As of September 30, 2025, the number of employees was 20, and in addition there were an average of 111 temporary employees.

entries.a17cd8c90e9d57a0: The company plans and develops soybean-processed foods such as tofu and soy milk, and “Mozo Original Products” such as bento boxes and confectionery. Production is entrusted to external partner companies.

entries.b0f3ce798d95faea: Sales from directly operated stores in the retail business
entries.b2340fc368abb0b3: Retail business through directly operated stores under the store name "Sandaime Mozō". It sells soybean-processed foods such as tofu and soy milk, as well as bento boxes and confectionery, and as of September 30, 2025 operated 30 stores. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,611 million.
entries.b74f7b44852ee61e: In addition to consumers who visit the directly operated store “Sandaime Mozo,” it sells to franchise stores, business customers and mail-order customers.
entries.b98be45c65ebc9de: Wholesale business to franchise stores under the store name "Sandaime Mozō", along with sales guidance, wholesale business to business customers, and mail-order business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥328 million.
entries.d153ae02a506c7ac: The reportable segments are two: the Retail Business and the Other Business. For the fiscal year ended September 2025, revenue from external customers of the Retail Business, at ¥2,611 million, accounted for the bulk of the total. Stores are located in Saitama, Tokyo, Kanagawa and Chiba, and there are no major customers accounting for 10% or more of revenue. There is no revenue from external customers outside Japan.
entries.d4261a7f1e5e7033: Soybean-processed foods such as tofu and soy milk
entries.eff9693976df3ee3: Because it handles everything from product planning and development to sales at its stores in-house and entrusts only production to external partner companies, it can concentrate its resources on store expansion without owning factories. It supplies “Mozo Original Products” developed with “health” as a keyword to both its directly operated stores and franchise stores, and has a sales network of 30 directly operated stores and 389 franchise stores (as of September 30, 2025).
entries.f5038dd9e6185b6f: It states that it aims to offer “better products at lower prices,” concentrates all of its management resources on the manufacturing retail (tofu-version SPA) business, and says it will work on developing original products to strengthen the brand power of “Sandaime Mozo,” renewing existing products, renovating existing stores, opening new stores and developing new business formats. It also cites securing and developing personnel and strengthening its compliance system as challenges.
